svg.title: St. Augustine HR Ops Platform ER model, steps 2 to 8
svg.text: ST. AUGUSTINE HR OPS PLATFORM · DATA MODEL · MICROSOFT DATAVERSE
For technical review. Revised 2026-10-07 by Nester Labs. Column details, decisions and open questions are in the model document.
Steps, top to bottom: 2 Person, Application, Employment · 3 Organization and Reference Data · 4 Compliance and Discipline · 5 Leave, FMLA and Insurance Claims
6 Benefits and Bonuses · 7 Workflow, Records and Verifications · 8 Security, Audit and Retention

g.text: zero or one to zero or many
dashed line: planned or optional link
Table from another step, or a Dataverse built-in
PK primary key · FK lookup · UK alternate key (unique business key)
Red column name: secured column (field security profile)
Types are logical: uuid = primary key or lookup; enum = choice;
text, date, numeric, bool map to the matching Dataverse column types.
Not drawn: Created By/On, Modified By/On and Owner,
which Dataverse adds to every table.

Crow's-foot notation. Header colour marks the area; dashed boxes are tables from other steps. Reference and code tables are foreign-key targets and aren't drawn. Every dated-terms row also carries produced_by_event_id back to

Dashed boxes are step 2 tables shown for context. Not drawn: job_assignment also references company and unit, company.default_facility_id references facility, application references department and position, and
employee_number references department (step 2). pick_list_value has no foreign keys by design.

Dashed boxes are step 2 tables shown for context. Not drawn: requirement_rule references company, job class and position (step 3); background_screening.employment_id (re-checks); evaluation.raise_event_id points to a step 2
status change; discipline_record.issued_by_person_id points to the director.
Step 5 · Leave, FMLA and Insurance Claims

Not drawn: insurance_claim.leave_case_id (a disability claim usually belongs to a leave; a death claim doesn't). The small loop under leave_case is prior_case_id: a medical leave continuing an exhausted FMLA leave.
employment is drawn twice to keep lines from crossing. Not drawn: bonus_program.job_class_code (step 3) and the built-in Created By and Modified By on every table.
Dashed boxes are step 2 tables and the built-in Task. Not drawn: paper_file.employment_id; checklist_step.owner_team_id → team (step 8).

Dashed boxes are Dataverse built-ins and the step 2 person. A role or profile reaches a user directly (systemuserroles, systemuserprofiles) or through a team (teamroles, teamprofiles); all four links and teammembership are

svg.text: Dataverse adds Created By/On, Modified By/On and Owner to every table (not drawn). Planned Dataverse solution prefix sta_ (not shown in names).
